title: Live: Pezeshkian set to address UN for the first time since US, Israel launched Iran war
summary: Iranian President Massoud Pezeshkian is scheduled to address the UN General Assembly (UNGA) Wednesday in his first speech at the world body since the US and Israel launched the Iran war.
